(137)phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam bshad/rab 'byams rgyal ba kun kyi spyi gzugs/o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab/mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyi gtsug ra

tei:div.tei:p: phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam bshad/ rab 'byams rgyal ba kun kyi spyi gzugs/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab/ mkhas dang grub pa yongs kyi gtsug rgyan/ 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdong*/ mtshungs bral rdo rje 'dzin dbang mchog dbus/ lung sde snod gsum dang*/ mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum gyis rgyud phyug pa'i/ dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i snyan lam du/ deng gi char/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa skal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i gdul zhing*/ stong gsum bye ba phrag brgya'i ya gyal/ mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ dzaṃ bu tṛk+ṣas brgyan pa'i zhing*/ rdo rje gdan byang chub snying po'i shing gis mngon par mdzes pa'i sa'i byang gi char/ gangs ri'i ra ba drug bcu rtsa gsum gyis brgyan pa'i bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs/ mdo khams sa'i thig le/ nor 'dzin lha mo'i dpal yon ma lus pa tshang ba'i sma shod go 'jo zhes/ legs sbyar gyi skad du/ go sgra don tshan dgu la 'jug kyang*/ mtho ris kyi dpal yon ma lus pa 'jo bas na/ go 'jo zhes/ 'jig rten lugs kyi mngon par mtho ba dang*/ bstan pa rin po che rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel/ thun mong dang thun (138)mong min pa'i shes bya rig pa'i gnas ji snyed pa'i tshig dang don gyi go ba ma lus pa thams cad 'jo bas na go 'jo zhes/ dam pa'i chos kyis sgo nas kyang gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i ming gi brda chad chags pa'i gnas 'di na/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa so thar gyi lnga phrug nyer gcig byang sems kyi yon tan bcu ldan/ gsang sngags kyi dbang phyug brgyad ldan sogs mtshan nyid ma tshang ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po chen pos dbu bzung*/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa tshul khrims rnam dag gser gyi sa gzhi la/ mang du thos pa'i rkang 'thung rnam par bkra zhing*/ zhi lhag gi lcug phran gzhon nu/ yon tan gyi lo 'dab dang 'bras bu'i tshogs rgyas pa/

bde ba dang*/ gya nom pa phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa'i 'dus pa rnams kyis/ chos phun sum tshogs pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba/ bka' rmad du byung ba/ theg pa thams cad kyi rtse rgyal/ grub mtha' thams cad kyi rgyal po/ zab lam thams cad kyi nying khu/ man ngag thams cad kyi bcud/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa/ nang rgyud yo ga sde gsum gyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhal phyes nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyis dbu bzung*/ lha sngags ting 'dzin gyis gzhung bsrangs/ bsngo ba smon (139)lam gyis rgyas btab/ 'brel tshad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dbugs chen 'byin/ lung chen thob/ rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i phrin las rmad du byung ba mdzad grub pa'i dus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ gnas dus ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi skabs 'dir/ bsod nams kyi tshogs chen rdzogs pa dang*/ gtan pa med pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i rten 'byung du/ bkra shis pa'i lha gos bcas lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas 'bul na/ dgyes pa'i spyan ras yud tsam g.yo ba'i rten du bzhes pa dang*/ legs byas rnam par dkar ba'i dge bas tshon dus gsum bsags yod kyi dge tshogs rgya mtsho ma lus pa thams cad phan bde'i 'byung gnas kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyis sgo nas 'dzin pa thams cad zhabs pad rin po che rdo rje'i khams ltar grub nas bzhed don thams cad gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams kyang*/ spang klog 'khor lo gnyis la rtag tu brtson pa dang*/ de dag gis mthus 'jig rten kun tu yang*/ nad mug mtshon (140)'khrug gi skal ngan nye bar zhi nas bde skyid kyi sgo 'phar gsar du bye zhing*/ gnas skabs su dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/

mthar thug sgrib gnyis dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa byang nas/ gtan gyi bde ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang rin po che 'thob pa'i phyir du/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i bzang po bzhi ldan gyi bsngo ba dang*/ smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs mdzad par zhu lags/// /
